name: codex-token-usage
description: Realtime Codex token usage and cost monitor for the VS Code status bar.

commands.title: Codex Token Monitor: Open Latest Session
Codex Token Monitor: Choose Sessions Folder

codexTokenMonitor.sessionsRoot.description: Codex sessions folder. Empty follows CODEX_HOME/sessions or ~/.codex/sessions. Archived siblings are included automatically.

codexTokenMonitor.accounts.description: Optional account list for comparing multiple Codex session folders.

label.description: Display name shown in the dashboard account selector.

sessionsRoot.description: Sessions folder for this account, for example C:\Users\PC\.codex\sessions.

codexTokenMonitor.refreshIntervalMs.description: Fallback polling interval in milliseconds. File watching is also used when available.

codexTokenMonitor.modelPrices.description: Optional model prices in USD per 1M tokens; keys are model IDs and values have input/cached/output numeric fields. Override built-in prices or add models.

codexTokenMonitor.priceMultiplier.description: Additional charge multiplier, e.g. 1.25 for a 25% markup. Applied after model and fast-tier pricing.

codexTokenMonitor.currencySymbol.description: Display currency symbol (e.g. $ or ¥). Does not convert by itself.

codexTokenMonitor.currencyRate.description: Display currency units per USD. E.g. 7.1 for CNY; use the provider's actual conversion rate.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/pricing.js && node --check src/grouping.js && node --check src/session-roots.js && node --check scripts/package-vsix.js
